o.text: Borrowed from Russian автомоби́ль (avtomobílʹ), from French automobile, from Ancient Greek αὐτός (autós) + Latin mobilis.
Inherited from Proto-Turkic *tütsüg. Cognate with Turkish tütsü.

From Proto-Turkic *yeŕne (“son-in-law, sister's husband”).
Cognate with Tatar җизни (cizni), Bashkir еҙнә (yiðnä), Kazakh жезде (jezde), Chuvash йысна (jysna).
From Persian صاحبکار (sâheb-kâr). By surface analysis, sahib + -kar.

Suffixed with -ovul. Ultimately from Proto-Mongolic *girgaxul. Cognate with Uyghur قىرغاۋۇل (qirghawul), Chagatai قىرغاۋۇل, Kazakh қырғауыл (qırğawıl),
Kumyk къыртавукъ (qırtawuq), Tatar кыргавыл (qırğawıl).
From Turkish gecekondu. Equivalent to gecə + qonmaq + qondu.
